distance_m.assumptions: Each serialized segment is one adjacency between its path-node endpoint coordinates.

elevation_delta_m.assumptions: Endpoint GLO-90 terrain values are approximate and not physical object heights.

ascent_m.assumptions: Only segments >=90 m publish ascent; shorter segments remain null because GLO-90 cannot support that precision.

descent_m.assumptions: Only segments >=90 m publish descent; shorter segments remain null because GLO-90 cannot support that precision.

avg_grade_pct.assumptions: Short-segment grade is explicitly null below the 90 m DEM horizontal resolution; long-segment grade remains coarse.

surface.assumptions: Missing OSM surface remains unknown; multiple conflicting source ways remain mixed/ambiguous.

access.assumptions: Missing access tags remain unknown and are never interpreted as accessible.

accessibility_status.assumptions: Unmapped representative-point snap connectors publish unknown_unmapped_connector and inherit no path accessibility facts.

model.next_function_representation: Each path node's next_segment_ids serializes the available directed functions to neighboring path nodes.
model.scope: Projection of the 122 qualified landmark walking edges, not every walkable OSM way in the park.
model.snap_connector_policy: Landmark representative-point to OSM-network connectors retain unknown surface/access/steps rather than inheriting path tags.
model.grade_policy: Per-segment grade/ascent/descent are emitted only for segments at least 90 m long. Shorter segments retain raw endpoint DEM elevations/delta but suppress derived terrain metrics because GLO-90 cannot support them at that scale.
